room_rent.note: Proportionate deduction applies if higher room taken. Waiver of Room Rent Capping available as optional add-on.

icu.note: ICU charges covered as part of Medical Expenses; no explicit separate ICU sub-limit found in base policy.

copayment.display: 20% if treated in higher-tier city than premium paid for
copayment.note: Tier-based co-pay: Tier 1b policyholders pay 20% in Tier 1a cities; Tier 2 policyholders pay 20% in Tier 1a/1b cities. No co-pay if room rent ≤₹5,000/day or accident. Co-pay also applies during PED waiting period. Waiver of Co-Payment available as optional add-on.

sub_limits.note: Cataract per eye ₹75,000; Benign tumors/cysts ₹75,000; Stone in urinary system ₹75,000; Hernia ₹75,000; Appendicectomy ₹75,000; Hysterectomy ₹75,000; Fissures/Piles/Fistulas ₹75,000; Cellulitis/Abscess ₹75,000. Waiver of Disease Capping available as optional add-on.

deductible.note: No base deductible. Aggregate Deductible is an optional add-on (amount per schedule); once opted cannot be removed at renewal.

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day waiting period for illnesses; not applicable for accidents.

ped_waiting.note: 36 months continuous coverage. Reducible via optional Waiting Period Modification add-on.

specific_disease_waiting.note: Extensive list including cataract, hernia, joint replacement, etc. Reducible via optional Waiting Period Modification add-on.

maternity.note: Maternity is a standard permanent exclusion (Excl18). Ectopic pregnancy is covered.

cumulative_bonus.note: 50% of Base SI added per renewal year regardless of claims, up to 100% max. Not applicable if Aggregate Deductible opted. Cumulative Bonus Booster optional add-on can modify the rate.

restoration.note: Sum Insured Rebound is an optional add-on: restores SI equal to claim paid, up to Base SI, on subsequent hospitalisation in same policy year. Not available if Aggregate Deductible opted. No inbuilt restoration in base plan.

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation expenses covered for 60 days before admission.

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation expenses covered for 180 days after discharge.

day_care.note: Day care treatment covered under Section 1.A.I.6.

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation covered when patient cannot be moved or no hospital room available.

ayush.note: AYUSH in-patient treatment covered up to limits in policy schedule at recognised AYUSH hospitals.

organ_donor.note: Organ donor hospitalisation expenses for harvesting covered; donor's pre/post-hosp excluded.

ambulance.note: Road ambulance covered for emergency transfer, inter-hospital transfer, and hospital-to-home. No explicit rupee limit stated in wording.

modern_treatments.note: Policy wording does not explicitly mention modern/robotic treatments as a named benefit or exclusion.

consumables.note: Non-Medical Expenses cover is an optional add-on (Optional Cover 1 under Section 1). Base policy excludes consumables/non-medical items.

global_cover.note: Emergency Medical Expenses (life-threatening, outside India) and Overseas Treatment for Major Illnesses are both optional add-ons.

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months, no claim contestable except on grounds of fraud.

grace_period.note: 30 days for yearly/half-yearly/quarterly; 15 days for monthly instalment.

free_look.note: Applicable on new policies only, not on renewals or porting.

portability.note: IRDAI portability norms apply; apply at least 30 days before renewal.

notable_exclusions.display: Maternity, OPD treatment, hearing aids/spectacles, stem cell harvesting, congenital external anomalies, sleep apnoea investigation, alopecia

optional_riders.display: Non-Medical Expenses, Aggregate Deductible, Emergency Global Cover, Overseas Treatment, Waiver of Disease Capping, Waiver of Room Rent, Waiting Period Modification, Medical Evacuation, Sum Insured Rebound, Waiver of Co-Payment, CB Booster
